results.title: Bounty award-xp: no idempotency, non-atomic claim, dead 404 branch
results.author: LunaUrsa
results.body_snippet: **Where:** `src/api/v2/bounty/bounty.routes.ts` (`POST /award-xp`) 1. **No idempotency.** The handler awards XP (`awardGitHubXP`) first and only then writes `claimed_bounties`. Nothing checks whether this bounty was already claimed, so a retried webhook or a repeated call grants the XP again. There is no unique key (issue/PR id) on the request. 2. **Not atomic.** If `db.claimed_bounties.create` throws after XP was granted, the user has the XP and there is no record, and a retry grants it again.

results.title: parse_duration drops the days (d) unit
results.author: tine1117
results.body_snippet: ## Bug `parse_duration` silently drops the **days** (`d`) unit. The README lists `d` as a supported unit, but the parser ignores it and returns a wrong (too-small) result instead of raising or counting it. ### Reproduction ```python from duration_utils import parse_duration parse_duration("1d") # -> 0 (expected 86400) parse_duration("2d4h") # -> 14400 (expected 187200) ``` ### Expected `d` should be counted as 86400 seconds, so `parse_duration("1d") == 86400` and `parse_duration("2d4h") == 18720
